El contrato entra en vigor el 10 de mayo de 2026. El precio es de 4.800 euros, pagaderos en 3 cuotas iguales.

The contract takes effect on 10 May 2026. The price is 4,800 euros, payable in 3 equal instalments.

The buyer, Industrias Lara S.L., must give notice before 1 June 2026. Telephone +34 91 5551234.
